environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL using AuthType=NONE. The function is publicly accessible without any authentication. No WAF or API Gateway in front. The HMAC_SECRET environment variable is not set (empty string), so validate_request_signature always returns True but is never actually called in the handler anyway. RDS MySQL instance is in the same VPC with no query-level firewall.

config.vpc_config: lambda and RDS in same VPC private subnets
